description: The individual is responsible for managing and optimising the flow of materials, components, and products through the plant to ensure that production runs smoothly and efficiently. The Executive works closely with other teams, such as production, inventory management, procurement, and logistics, to contribute to the day-to-day supply chain activities within the plant. The individual is responsible for performing all tactical procurement functions, inventory analysis, and transportation management, including transportation of ODC and project cargo.
typeOfQualification: General, Upskilling, Fresh Skilling, Future Skills

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Conduct day to day procurement activities
Perform basic inventory analysis and forecasting
Perform basic data analysis and report generation using ERP
Undertake basic Negotiation and Vendor Selection
Transportation and Route Optimization through all modes of transport
Prepare clearance documents and Perform EDI filing
Follow health, safety, security procedures and maintain integrity, ethics at workplace
Plan and Coordinate for transportation of Project cargo and ODC
